name: EZFlora
description: An 8-zone irrigation controller with 4 program schedules. It runs one zone at a time, can use zone 8 as a pump zone, and can stop watering when its rain sensor input says it's raining.

verification.note: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008) gives 0x04/0x00 to the Compacta EZRain Sprinkler Controller and lists no EZFlora; the HouseLinc device catalog gives the same identity to the EZRain as model 31270. That the EZFlora reports it is read from those entries: no other irrigation controller from Compacta is listed, and no EZFlora document gives a category.
The Quick Start Guide - EZFlora Model #5010A links zone N by tapping the SET button N times; numbering the zones as groups 1 to 8 follows that.

notes: Each valve wires to a Zone 1 to 8 terminal and to Comm; a 24 V AC transformer connects to the two AC Xmr terminals. Each zone drives one valve, 500 mA at most.

Each zone has a maximum run of 30 minutes, so a missed Off doesn't leave it running. Zone 8 can be set up as a pump zone that turns on with any other zone. Timers and programs need a gateway or software to set up.

The RJ-45 accessory port isn't for data or Ethernet. For a rain sensor, connect a 4.7 kΩ resistor between pins 2 and 6 and the sensor between pins 6 and 7; for a water meter, connect it between pins 4 and 5. Both must be enabled in the configuration register.

To link a zone as a responder: hold the controller's button until it blinks; hold the EZFlora's SET button about 4 seconds (its LED goes out); tap the SET button once per zone number; then hold it about 4 seconds.
X10: the unit code picks the zone (A1 for zone 1). Hold the SET button about 4 seconds (the LED blinks steadily), then send the X10 On command 3 times within 30 seconds; an Off disables X10.
Factory reset: unplug it for at least 5 seconds, then hold the SET button while plugging it back in, for 5 seconds.
The HouseLinc device catalog lists this identity as the Compacta EZRain Sprinkler Controller, model 31270.
sources: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008)
